The Company's improved financial performance metrics for the first half of 2026 include a net interest margin of 3.75% and an efficiency ratio of 57.70%, as compared to a net interest margin of 3.71% and efficiency ratio of 60.00% for the same period in 2025.

● Strong YTD Earnings and Profitability (first half compared to same period last year) o Diluted earnings per share increased by $0.29, or 20%, to $1.72 per diluted share. o Return on average assets rose to 1.24%, as compared to 1.09%. o Return on average equity expanded to 12.38%, as compared to 11.26%. o Net interest margin remained strong at 3.75%, increasing four basis points from 3.71%. o Efficiency ratio (1) improved to 57.70%, as compared to 60.00%.

Diluted earnings per share increased 20% to $1.72 compared to $1.43 in the comparative period. ● Net interest income increased $0.3 million due primarily to a four basis point increase in net interest margin to 3.75%, partially offset by slightly lower average earning assets.

The reduction in funding costs more than offset the modest decline in earning asset yields, resulting in a six basis point increase in the net interest margin to 3.74% from 3.68% in the second quarter of 2025.
